images.subtitle: From raw text to a chat assistant: practice, feedback and testing, step by step.

images.title: Three stages turn raw text into a chat assistant

items.label: Pre-training
items.text: The model learns language by guessing the next token in huge text collections.

items.label: Tuning for chat
items.text: People write good answers and rank outputs, so it follows instructions.

items.label: Testing
items.text: Teams run benchmarks and try to break it before release.

images.note: After release the numbers are frozen. Chatting does not change them.

images.title: One training step is guess, compare, nudge

items.label: Show text
items.text: The model sees a piece of text with the next token hidden.

items.label: Guess
items.text: It gives a score to every possible next token.

items.label: Compare
items.text: Its score for the real next token shows how wrong it was.

items.label: Nudge
items.text: Parameters shift slightly so that token scores a little higher.
